name: King of the Underhive
summary: Once per long rest, for 1 minute, you may take two bonus actions on each of your turns. Each bonus action must be used for Cunning Action, a Gang Style feature, reloading, drawing a weapon, interacting with the battlefield, or making one attack with a pistol or light melee weapon. You can make only one such bonus-action attack per turn, and Dirty Fighter still triggers only once per turn unless another feature explicitly says otherwise.
